title: cerasus × compta
intro: Cerasus × compta, commonly known as cherry plum, is a hybrid of the Japanese plum (Prunus salicina) and the European plum (Prunus domestica). This plant is valued for its rich nutritional profile, with numerous health benefits, including supporting heart health, reducing inflammation, and providing antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of cherry plum include its potential to regulate blood sugar levels, improve digestion, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. Bioactive constituents of the cherry plum plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and anthocyanins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
